notes: Frozen Frontier scenery on the snow around the Stronghold: every v1 ruins-kit module and every v2 landmark and winter plant (public/frozen-frontier/game, scripts/frozen-frontier-map/build-assets.mjs).

kit: per sprite, its layer (ground = flat decal under actors, upright = depth-sorted prop that hides actors behind it, cap = snow overlay drawn just in front of the wall it sits on) and block, its solid ground footprint as tile rectangles [u0, v0, u1, v1] around the sprite's ground pivot. Rectangles scale with a placement's s.

placements: a = kit sprite, u/v = ground pivot in map tiles (same space as arkodia-01.json terrain), s = optional size factor, lift = a snow cap's height above its wall's ground pivot in world px, on = the wall a cap sits on (its footprint orders the cap against actors), zone = the area it dresses. Written by scripts/frozen-frontier-map/layout.mjs, which keeps props off raised terrain, paths and the combat clearing before the gate.

Collision: src/world/frontier.ts turns every block rectangle into 4 px footprint columns, the same column rule as the court's sprites (hero.ts blocked, net/movement.ts navBlocker). server/internal/sim/frontier.go reads a byte-identical copy of this file and builds the same columns; TestFrontierMatchesClient fails when the copies differ.
